authorityScope: User-delegated product/source authoring decision; not independent acceptance/native authority
rationale: Preview is observation-only; apply and compensating rollback change canonical state and require genuine exact-diff approval. Separate typed input contracts make effect and approval boundaries explicit. Both original features remain fully in scope.

mandatoryConditions.criterion: Retain both audit identities and trace the entire dry-run/diff/scope/undo feature across the two selected capabilities, with explicit dependency from apply to the exact preview revision/diff.

Apply and rollback must explicitly identify action, expected revision, exact authorized scope, genuine approval evidence and resulting new revision; rollback is compensating revision, never history deletion.
Unknown effect outcome is reconciled before any retry; stale/denied/missing approval cannot commit; dry-run never commits.

Retain full existing 52 typed edit-kind semantics and applicable GUI/keyboard/text/CLI/SDK/API parity and round-trip criteria. Do not replace them with a generic transaction wrapper or claim runtime implementation.
Capability operation references in cases use exact canonical identity, not concatenated duplicate feature.operation strings; parent-case source links resolve by matching polarity.

requiredNextAction: Generate exact selected split postimages/current CAS proposal and obtain distinct source peer before actual owner application. Preserve unselected shared alternative as immutable history.
